title: How AlphaFold Cracked the Protein Folding Problem

slides.heading: How AlphaFold Cracked the Protein Folding Problem
slides.body: A 50-year grand challenge in biology — finally solved by AI

slides.heading: What Is Protein Folding?
slides.body: Proteins are chains of amino acids that twist into precise 3D shapes. That shape determines everything — how enzymes catalyze reactions, how antibodies fight disease, how receptors receive signals.

slides.heading: The 50-Year Grand Challenge
slides.body: Since the 1970s, scientists knew that a protein's shape is encoded in its amino acid sequence. But predicting that shape computationally was considered one of biology's hardest unsolved problems.

slides.heading: How AlphaFold Works
slides.body: DeepMind's AlphaFold uses a transformer-based neural network trained on hundreds of thousands of experimentally determined protein structures. It learns the physical and evolutionary rules of folding from data.

slides.heading: The CASP14 Breakthrough
slides.body: In 2020, AlphaFold2 dominated the CASP14 competition — the Olympics of protein structure prediction — achieving accuracy that matched expensive lab techniques like X-ray crystallography for the first time.

slides.heading: 200 Million Structures, Free
slides.body: In 2021, DeepMind released the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database containing predictions for over 200 million proteins — virtually every protein in every known organism — available to any researcher for free.

slides.heading: Accelerating Drug Discovery
slides.body: AlphaFold has cut drug target identification from years to weeks. It has already contributed to new antibiotics, antiparasitic treatments, and cancer therapy candidates by revealing previously unknown protein shapes.

slides.heading: Where It Still Falls Short
slides.body: AlphaFold predicts static snapshots, but proteins constantly flex and shift. Understanding protein dynamics, intrinsically disordered regions, and complex interactions remains a major open challenge.

slides.heading: AlphaFold 3: The Next Leap
slides.body: Released in 2024, AlphaFold 3 extended predictions to entire molecular complexes — proteins with DNA, RNA, and small-molecule drugs — dramatically expanding its usefulness in pharmaceutical research.

slides.heading: A New Lens on Life
slides.body: AlphaFold didn't just solve a puzzle — it handed scientists a tool to read the language of biology at a molecular level. The ripple effects on medicine and science are only beginning to unfold.
